name: Inspired Arcanist (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
body:
Knowledge is power. That’s what wizards say. They are almost right: secrets are power.

Inspiration (Ex)

At 3rd level, the inspired arcanist learns to use their innate power to augment and enhance their mental skills. When making a skill check, they may spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir as a free action to add 1d6 to the result of that check, including any check on which they take 10 or 20. This choice is made after the check is rolled and before the results are revealed. The inspired arcanist can only use inspiration once per check or roll. The inspired arcanist can use inspiration on any Knowledge, Linguistics, or Spellcraft skill checks without expending a use of inspiration, provided they are trained in the skill.

This ability counts as an investigator’s inspiration ability for the purpose of prerequisites. Any ability that requires spending inspiration uses points from the arcane reservoir instead.

This replaces unconventional thinking.

Inspired Talents

At 7th level, and again at 11th, 15th, and 19th level, the inspired arcanist gains an investigator talent of their choice, chosen from the following list: Amazing Inspiration, Applied Engineering, Device Talent, Eidetic Recollection, Empathy, Expanded Inspiration, Hidden Agendas, Inspirational Expertise, Inspired Intelligence, Item Lore, Perceptive Tracking, Tenacious Inspiration, Unconventional Inspiration, Underworld Inspiration.

To choose a talent, the inspired arcanist must have a class level equal to or higher than any minimum investigator level the talent requires, and they must meet all other prerequisites as well. Any talent that requires the expenditure of inspiration points uses points from the inspired arcanist’s arcane reservoir instead.

Arcanist Exploits

An inspired arcanist can choose from the following additional arcanist exploits.

Alchemical Research

Choose one spell from the investigator’s spell list and add it to your own spell list and spell book as a spell of equal level. Once chosen, your choice can not be changed.

Practiced Skill

Choose one skill in which the inspired arcanist is trained. They may add their inspiration die to checks with this skill without expending any points from their arcane reservoir. If this skill is not a class skill, it becomes a class skill.
